feature: PF-84 #555: named accounts for forks, cross-provider resume, [provider_accounts] and recovery (PRs #561, #566)
designer: corbanu exec claude-opus-5-5-plan high, fresh session 2026-10-12 (see designer-session.md)

cases.title: `/fork` stays on the source account
cases.starting_conditions: H-ZAI. Start with `corbanu --account work`, so the config points to `personal` and the session runs on `work`. Send 1 prompt.
actions: `/fork`, then send a prompt in the fork, then `/status`.
expected: The screen shows "Thread forked from <source id>".
In `/status`, "Model provider" ends in `· account work` and "Forked from" shows the source id.
"Account usage" grows for `work` only. `personal` and `default` show no new tokens.
Screen 01 is consistent with this. On the earlier build (screen 11), the tokens went to `personal` while `/status` said `work`.

cases.title: Fork of a resumed conversation (account comes from the recording, not a flag)
cases.starting_conditions: H-ZAI. Resume a conversation recorded on `work` without using `--account`.
actions: `/fork`, send a prompt, then `/status`.
expected: `/status` says `account work`.
Only `work` is charged, not `personal` from the config.

cases.title: Editing an earlier prompt (which forks)
cases.starting_conditions: As in FK-01, with at least 2 turns.
actions: Go back and edit the first prompt.
Submit the edit.
Run `/status`.
expected: A new forked thread is created.
`/status` says `account work`.
Only `work` is charged.
No screen covers this case.

cases.title: Side conversation (`/side`)
cases.starting_conditions: As in FK-01.
actions: `/side`, send a prompt, then `/status`.
Switch back to the main thread (Ctrl+/), send a prompt, then `/status`.
expected: Both the side and main conversations show `account work`.
Only `work` is charged in both.
Screen 02 shows `work` for the side conversation.
Editing previous prompts is blocked in the side conversation with the notice shown in screen 02.

cases.title: `corbanu fork <id>` from the command line
cases.starting_conditions: H-ZAI, with a conversation recorded on `work`.
actions: Run `corbanu fork <id>`, send a prompt, then `/status`.
expected: The fork opens on `work`.
`/status` shows `account work` and the "Forked from" id.
Only `work` is charged.
No screen covers this case.

cases.title: An explicit `--account` beats the source account
cases.starting_conditions: As in FK-05.
actions: Run `corbanu fork <id> --account personal`, then run it again with `--account zai:personal`.
expected: Both forks run on `personal`, and `/status` says `personal`.
`work` is not charged.

cases.title: Fork when the source account has since been removed
cases.starting_conditions: A conversation recorded on `work`, after which `work` is removed from the vault.
actions: Run `corbanu fork <id>`. Separately, run `/fork` inside a session resumed on that conversation, if that can be reached.
expected: An error names `zai` / `work` and how to recover.
Nothing falls back silently to `default` or `personal`, and no tokens are charged.

cases.title: Fork of a fork
cases.starting_conditions: As in FK-01.
actions: `/fork`, then `/fork` again, send a prompt, then `/status`.
expected: The account is still `work`.
"Forked from" shows the immediate parent.

cases.title: Worker or child agent inherits the parent's account
cases.starting_conditions: A session on `work` that spawns a worker agent.
actions: Let the worker run a turn, then check usage.
expected: The worker's tokens are charged to `work`, as the precedence constraint requires.

cases.title: Credentials present
cases.starting_conditions: H-OAI.
actions: Run `corbanu resume <zai-work-id>`, send a prompt, then `/status`.
expected: The transcript loads with no OpenAI sign-in or onboarding screen.
The model is Z.AI.
"Model provider" is Z.AI `· account work`, and only `work` is charged.
Screens 03 and 04 are consistent with this. On the earlier build, screen 14 showed the Z.AI key prompt instead.

cases.title: Credentials missing
cases.starting_conditions: H-OAI-bare.
actions: Run `corbanu resume <zai-work-id>`.
expected: A message names provider `zai` and account `work`, and gives the recovery: `corbanu account add zai work` and/or `--account`.
No onboarding, sign-in or key-entry screen appears.
The command exits with a non-zero code, and no model call is made.
No candidate screen covers this case.

cases.title: Only `default` is enrolled for the recorded provider
cases.starting_conditions: H-OAI with only Z.AI `default` enrolled.
actions: Resume the conversation recorded on `work`.
expected: An error names `work`. The session does not fall back silently to `default`.

cases.title: Resume through the picker matches resume by id
cases.starting_conditions: H-OAI, and H-OAI-bare.
actions: Run `corbanu resume`, select the Z.AI conversation, and press Enter.
expected: The outcome is the same as RS-01 (H-OAI) or RS-02 (H-OAI-bare).

cases.title: Resuming twice keeps the recorded account
cases.starting_conditions: RS-01 has been completed.
actions: Exit, then run `corbanu resume <same id>` again.
expected: The session is still on `work`. Resuming did not rewrite the recorded account to the home's defaults.

cases.title: Recorded account exists
cases.starting_conditions: H-ZAI with `zai = "ghost"` in the config. The conversation is recorded on `work`.
actions: Run `corbanu resume <id>`, send a prompt, then `/status`.
expected: The session resumes on `work`, and `/status` says `account work`.
Only `work` is charged.
Screen 05 is consistent with this. On the earlier build, screen 13 exited with code 1.

cases.title: Recorded account is missing too
cases.starting_conditions: Same config as GH-01, but `work` has been removed.
actions: Run `corbanu resume <id>`.
expected: The error names the recorded account, `work`, and gives `corbanu account add zai work` as the recovery.
It ideally also mentions `ghost`.
Nothing falls back to `default`, and the exit code is non-zero.
No screen covers this case.

cases.title: New session with `ghost` in the config
cases.starting_conditions: The same `ghost` config.
actions: Run `corbanu` to start a new session, not a resume.
expected: An error names `ghost` with the recovery. The session does not start silently on `default`.

cases.title: Inside the TUI
cases.starting_conditions: A running session on any account, with a stored conversation recorded on `work`, which has since been removed.
actions: `/resume`, then select that conversation.
expected: The message names `zai` / `work` and points to `/providers`. It does not mention `corbanu account add` or `--account`.
The current session stays open and usable.
Screen 10 is consistent with this. On the earlier build, screen 15 pointed to the command line.

cases.title: Recovery through `/providers` without restarting
cases.starting_conditions: Right after MSG-01.
actions: Open `/providers` and add account `work`.
`/resume` the same conversation again.
Send a prompt, then `/status`.
expected: The conversation resumes on `work`, and only `work` is charged.

cases.title: On the command line
cases.starting_conditions: The same situation as RS-02 or GH-02.
actions: Run `corbanu resume <id>`.
expected: The message points to `corbanu account add …` and `--account`. It does not mention `/providers`.

cases.title: Session after a failed in-app resume
cases.starting_conditions: Right after MSG-01.
actions: Send a prompt, then `/status`.
expected: The original session id and account are unchanged. The tokens are charged to that original account.

cases.title: Esc in the `corbanu resume` picker when there are no credentials
cases.starting_conditions: H-NOKEY.
actions: Run `corbanu resume`, then press Esc.
expected: The process exits cleanly with code 0 and the terminal is restored.
No sign-in or onboarding screen appears.
Screens 06 and 07 are consistent with this. On the earlier build, screen 12 showed the onboarding screen.

cases.title: Ctrl+C in the same picker
cases.starting_conditions: H-NOKEY.
actions: Run `corbanu resume`, then press Ctrl+C.
expected: Same as ESC-01.

cases.title: Esc in the in-session `/resume` picker
cases.starting_conditions: A running session with a draft in the composer and at least one turn.
actions: `/resume`, press Esc, then `/status`.
expected: You are back in the same session.
The session id, account and transcript are unchanged, and the draft is still there.
Screen 08 is consistent with this.

cases.title: Normal onboarding is not broken
cases.starting_conditions: A fresh home with no credentials.
actions: Run `corbanu`, which is not a resume.
expected: Onboarding still appears as it did before the change.

cases.title: Full precedence order
cases.starting_conditions: H-ZAI, plus a conversation recorded on `work`.
actions: Run each of the following, then `/status`:
Resume with `--account personal`.
Resume with no flag.
Start a new session with no flag.
Start a new session with no flag after removing `[provider_accounts]`.
expected: The accounts used are `personal`, `work`, `personal` and `default`, in that order.

cases.title: `--account` for another provider does not affect Z.AI
cases.starting_conditions: A conversation recorded on Z.AI `work`.
actions: Resume it with `--account openai:x`.
expected: The Z.AI session still uses `work`. Whatever happens with `openai:x` is clearly reported.

cases.title: `named_accounts` turned off
cases.starting_conditions: The same homes, with the feature off.
actions: Repeat FK-01, RS-01, ESC-01 and ESC-03.
expected: Behaviour and text match the build from before this change.
`/status` shows no account suffix or per-account usage, as was the case before.

cases.title: No secrets shown
cases.starting_conditions: All the error and status paths above.
actions: Check the screens, exit output, transcripts and logs.
expected: No API key or any part of one appears anywhere.

cases.title: Footer and `/status` agree
cases.starting_conditions: A session on `work`.
actions: Compare the bottom status line with `/status`.
expected: Both name the same account.
Every candidate screen shows "via zai default" in the footer, even when `/status` says `account work`. Find out whether that "default" means the account; if it does, it is wrong.

cases.title: Usage totals add up
cases.starting_conditions: Any session after a few turns.
actions: Compare the per-turn "Token usage" line, "Token usage" in `/status`, and "Account usage".
expected: The numbers agree, given how the inherited fork history is counted.
Other accounts are listed with 0, or the reason they are left out is clear.
In screen 01, "Token usage" is 27.3K but `work` shows 13,023 input. In screen 09, there are 20,160 cached tokens against 8.4K total.

cases.title: "Account:" line in `/status`
cases.starting_conditions: RS-01 and GH-01.
actions: Run `/status`.
expected: The "Account:" credential line shows the active credential, or there is an explanation for why it is missing.
It is missing in screens 04 and 05, but present in screens 01, 02 and 09.

cases.title: Both platforms
actions: Run the blocker cases on macOS and Linux.
expected: The results are the same on both.
